rationale: Critical deadlock introduced in the interrupt path: interrupt() holds workflow_execution_lock (non-reentrant threading.Lock, line 137) and the new record_transition() call inside _interrupt_predecessor_state() re-acquires the same lock (line 368), causing every workflow interrupt to hang permanently. A serialization failure in _check_for_interruption also silently converts a clean pause into a task exception. A test-class name mismatch against the spec AC is also flagged. 10 noise findings dismissed; 6 pre-existing edge cases deferred (not introduced by this change).

findings.title: record_transition re-acquires non-reentrant lock
findings.problem: interrupt() acquires self.workflow_execution_lock (threading.Lock, non-reentrant) at line 137. The new _interrupt_predecessor_state() call chain reaches record_transition() which re-acquires the same lock at line 368. threading.Lock is not reentrant, so the second acquisition blocks forever.
findings.impact: Every workflow interrupt hangs permanently — the interrupt-before feature is broken for all workflows after this change.
findings.recommendation: Extract the WorkflowExecutionTransition creation and .save() inside record_transition into a private _record_transition_unlocked() helper that assumes the lock is already held, and call it directly from _interrupt_predecessor_state. Alternatively, change workflow_execution_lock to threading.RLock() to allow reentrant acquisition by the same thread.

findings.title: Serialization failure converts interrupt into task exception
findings.problem: In _check_for_interruption, if serialize_state(checkpoint_values) or check_state_size(...) raises an exception, it propagates out of _check_for_interruption. The caller's except chain catches Exception generically before InterruptedException, so the interrupt is silently converted to a workflow task failure with no recovery.
findings.impact: A non-serializable value in workflow state (e.g. a non-JSON-serializable LangGraph message type) turns a clean interrupt-before pause into a failed workflow execution, losing user context.
findings.recommendation: Wrap the serialize_state/check_state_size block in try/except Exception and fall back to raising InterruptedException(last_message, interrupted_state, None) on failure, preserving interrupt semantics while degrading gracefully without checkpoint data.

findings.title: Spec-named test class absent from repository
findings.problem: The spec's acceptance criteria require TestTransitionViewerReportsFalseTerminalOnInterrupt to exist and pass. The diff creates TestTransitionViewerNoLongerFalseTerminalOnInterrupt instead. The spec-named class does not exist anywhere in the repository.
findings.impact: The AC is technically unmet; auditing against the spec by class name fails.
findings.recommendation: Rename TestTransitionViewerNoLongerFalseTerminalOnInterrupt to TestTransitionViewerReportsFalseTerminalOnInterrupt to satisfy the spec's explicit AC naming requirement.
